abilities.name: thick-fat
abilities.effect: Halves damage from fire and ice moves.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: ice-body
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail.  Protects against hail damage.

kanto.flavorText: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.

original-johto.flavorText: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg- filled oceans.

hoenn.flavorText: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

updated-johto.flavorText: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.

original-unova.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

updated-unova.flavorText: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.

kalos.flavorText: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.

updated-alola.flavorText: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don’t bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
